name: Camp Evergreen
description_short: A day camp in Harold Parker State Forest in Andover, MA, for ages 5 to 14, with lakes, ponds and hiking trails. Activities include swimming, canoeing, football and woodshop, and the camp also runs a spring vacation week.
refund_policy_summary: A 25% per-week registration fee is included in tuition and is non-refundable. Tuition is due in full by May 1 and is non-refundable once paid. Cancellations must be in writing before May 1 for any refund; camp credit only for documented medical withdrawals. 5% early-bird discount before January 31.
swim_waterfront_notes: The camp has an in-ground pool with a diving board, an above-ground pool and a boating pond. Only deep-end swimmers may go on canoe trips. The pages checked do not say how swim levels are tested or about lifeguards.
